name: carolina-portal-frontend
description: Frontend UI for Carolina order portal

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join('node_modules','occt-import-js','dist','occt-import-js.wasm');const dst=path.join('public','occt-import-js.wasm');try{fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('WASM copied to public/')}catch(e){console.error('WASM copy failed:',e.message);process.exit(1)}"
